Paragraph 1
Empowerment of Women Victims of Violence

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Gorontalo.
2. Mayor is the Head of the Region.
3. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous Region.
4. Regional Governance is the administration of government affairs by the Regional Government and the Regional House of Representatives according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
5. Woman is a person who is female by sex.
6. Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old, including a child who is still in the womb.
7. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
- 5 -
8. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
9. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, and other violence.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs in the area of the City of Gorontalo.
11. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will, is, or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is, or has occurred.
14. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to accompany victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service unit established by the Region to provide services in the context of empowerment of women and children victims of violence.
16. Safe House is a shelter for victims, during the accompaniment process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators.
17. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
18. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers and reside in that household.
19. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence, hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK, is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.

Article 10
Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits either material or immaterial; and/or
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

Article 3
Victim Protection aims to:
a. prevent violence against women and children;
b. provide services to Victims; and
c. carry out empowerment for women victims of violence.

Article 12
Letter a What is meant by "to be respected for their dignity and worth as human beings" is upholding human rights.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c Sufficiently clear.
Letter d What is meant by "obtaining information" is the right to obtain explanations, statements, ideas, and signs that contain value, meaning, and messages, whether data, facts or their explanations that can be seen, heard, and read that are presented in various packages and formats in accordance with the development of information and communication technology either electronically or non-electronically related to acts of violence.
Letter e Sufficiently clear.
Letter f What is meant by "compensation" includes: economic empowerment, repatriation costs, health insurance, and education or skills training.
Letter g What is meant by "social rehabilitation" includes: access to medical services for physical and psychological recovery, legal assistance to restore civil rights, restoration of good name, and citizenship.
Letter h What is meant by "complaint handling" is the availability of a special integrated service unit by officers.
Letter i Sufficiently clear.
Letter j What is meant by "assistance" includes among others: psychologists, psychiatrists, health experts, religious counselors, advocates, and family members.
Letter a Sufficiently clear.
Letter b What is meant by "basic services" includes among others: the right to education, health and access to parents during the handling process.
Letter c What is meant by "equal protection" is related to status, citizenship, race, skin color, gender, language, belief, religion, politics, ethnicity or social life, ownership, disability, birth or other status.
Letter d Sufficiently clear.
Letter e What is meant by "obtaining freedom" is freedom to express their views on all matters, including those related to legal processes, care and temporary protection as well as identification and implementation of subsequent solutions.

PROVINCE OF GORONTALO
REGIONAL REGULATION OF GORONTALO CITY
NUMBER 7 YEAR 2016
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST
VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

Article 32
Empowerment of women victims of violence includes:
a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and/or joint business groups; and
c. capital assistance.

2.3.rationale: The original Indonesian text DOES establish a data/reporting mechanism: Pasal 38 huruf e states FPKK must "mengumpulkan, menyusun, dan menyajikan laporan data korban kekerasan" (collect, compile, and present reports/data on victims of violence). This is directly a data collection/reporting function (an information system element). That same content was present in the retrieved English candidates ([4.1-49]/[4.4-49]) but was not retrieved under indicator 2.3; however, even within the 2.3 candidates, the judge’s rationale focused on the absence of explicit data systems and ignored that the regulation elsewhere mandates data reporting. Given the ground truth, the correct label is Yes; the pipeline’s No stems from the judge being overly strict about what counts as a data system (discounting mandated collection/reporting of victim data as not a system).

4.1.evaluator_rationale: The policy includes primary prevention measures that explicitly involve information dissemination and education, including socialization of relevant laws and providing critical education on women’s and children’s rights to the community.

Pasal 21 ayat (2) huruf d requires "melakukan sosialisasi tentang peraturan perundang-undangan" related to protection of women/children victims of violence, and huruf e requires "memberikan pendidikan kritis tentang hak-hak perempuan dan anak bagi masyarakat".
